levels.surface: أبو الحسن محمد بن سعيد بن عزيز السمرقندي
أبو أحمد محمد بن محمد الزاهد السمرقندي

notes: «- الفقيه بأرض بلخ -» is an epithet gloss and is left out; «بإسناده» is a back reference with no previous report in the context, and «رفعه» marks the raising; «سأله رجل» gives the unnamed asker, who transmits the answer (rule 5), then the Imam; the narrated encounter in which the Imam answers a man is a rule 11 case, so the ruling is flagged
